SIGNALS.name: Andrew Curran
SIGNALS.summary: Relays a rumor, also mentioned on Scott Aaronson's blog, that Anthropic and OpenAI may have math results that could crack RSA. Unconfirmed.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Reports that Cognition released SWE-2.1, its new coding model, free for two weeks. It succeeds SWE-2 and is trained with reinforcement learning on Kimi K3.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI shares a preprint with lab validation of protein design by its GPT-6 family. Of 322 proteins tested with a partner, 35 showed binding evidence, with binders for all five targets.

SIGNALS.name: Polymarket
SIGNALS.summary: Citing Axios, Polymarket reports that OpenAI and Anthropic employees fear their most advanced internal models may be too powerful to release safely.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says ecommerce and online service businesses based outside the U.S. can now claim their business and publish agents in ChatGPT.

SIGNALS.name: Mani
SIGNALS.summary: Reports Sarvam AI says its Token Factory inference platform runs on privately procured GPUs, not government-subsidised compute, after criticism over hosting Chinese open-weight models.

SIGNALS.name: Anthropic
SIGNALS.summary: Anthropic says it priced its IPO at $83 per share, with trading on Nasdaq expected to begin on November 19. The SEC declared the registration effective on November 18.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI shares new data on AI's role in its own research: researchers' AI use keeps rising and agents finish longer tasks, while humans stay central and spend more time on safety work.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind begins rolling out Gemini 4 Neon, positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen, for software engineering, knowledge work and science tasks.
